# evroc_bucket_service_account_secret (Data Source)

Deprecated. Use the sensitive `access_key_id` and `secret_access_key` attributes on `evroc_bucket_service_account` instead. Existing configurations continue to work during the deprecation period.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Credential identifier returned by `evroc_bucket_service_account.credentials_secret`. This is not the bucket service account name.

### Read-Only

- `access_key_id` (String, Sensitive) S3 access key ID.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `secret_access_key` (String, Sensitive) S3 secret access key.
